intro.text: A weightlifter in Kilahito, a friend of Tojin and a regular at the Noodle Pupil.

items.text: Gaino had given Tojin a tip about the lat press that Tojin found very helpful. At the Noodle Pupil, Tojin took off his shirt to show the results and Gaino asked about his reps: four sets of twenty. Yumi watched them to understand Tojin better.
